llm_response.reason: The website displays numerous scam signs: unusually low prices and big sales, references to non-existent or spoofed brands, vague or missing company and policy information, and a lack of credible contact details. Many online users report being scammed—experiencing delivery issues, non-responsiveness to support requests, and poor product quality associated with similar sites. Customer protection measures and business legitimacy are not verifiable, matching criteria for scam websites under fake online shopping scams.
